statement: CoreWeave North America lists on-demand HGX H100 8-GPU nodes at $49.24 per hour and HGX H200 8-GPU nodes at $50.44 per hour.
why: Published on-demand node rates at a large GPU cloud show where rented Hopper-class compute is currently priced, though the page gives no prior level to compare against.

impact.mechanism: Node-hour list prices define the observable cost of rented accelerator capacity; with no stated baseline this is a level reading only.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX H100 (8 GPUs): $49.24/hr on-demand. NVIDIA HGX H200 (8 GPUs): $50.44/hr on-demand.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public pricing page with no publication or last-updated date; quoted figures are per full 8-GPU node, not per GPU.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 68.8 -> 49.24 (tol 1%); sources: CoreWeave (coreweave.com)
